stem:
Meera feels feverish at home in Pune, so her mother uses a digital clinical thermometer to check her body temperature.
Which action gives a safe and correct temperature reading?

options.text: placing the tip under Meera's tongue and reading the number as soon as it appears
placing the tip under Meera's tongue while she keeps her mouth open during the reading
washing only the metal tip before use and reading it after the beep
washing the tip before and after use, placing it under Meera's tongue with her mouth closed, and reading it after the beep

teacher.key_rationale: A correct clinical thermometer reading requires full hygiene (washing before and after use), correct placement (under the tongue, mouth closed), and waiting for the beep. Only D includes all steps; A omits waiting for the beep, B omits closing the mouth and full hygiene, C omits washing after use and leaves placement unstated.
